name: secaudit
description: Authorized, defensive security audit engine for Claude Code. Scans a live URL or source-code repo for known (CVE/dependency) and unknown (logic/code) vulnerabilities across the OWASP Web/API/LLM/Mobile Top 10 and CWE Top 25, using installed scanners (semgrep, trivy, osv-scanner, gitleaks, testssl.sh) when available and LLM analysis otherwise. Produces a prioritized, remediation-focused report. Safe/passive by default; active testing requires explicit authorization.
